component-o.description-s: 1 µH ±20% shielded power inductor, SRP4020TA series, 4.45 x 4.06 x 2.0 mm, DCR 27 mΩ max, Irms 5.0 A, Isat 8.5 A, AEC-Q200; buyable replacement for the obsolete Coilcraft XAL4020-102MEB (STM32N6 SMPS coil)

specs-o.current_note_s: Bourns SRP table: Isat = inductance drops 20 % (typ); Irms = 40 °C rise
specs-o.impedance_note_s: Bourns SRP4020TA datasheet p1 Electrical Specifications: L 1.0 uH +/-20 % and Q >= 10 at 100 kHz / 1 V, SRF 65 MHz typ, DCR 22 mOhm typ / 27 max. impedance_ohm is |Z| = 2*pi*100 kHz*1.0 uH at the stated L test point; the datasheet publishes no impedance-vs-frequency curve or S-parameters
